definitions.explanation: the part of the nervous system that controls involuntary bodily functions such as heart rate, digestion, and breathing

notes:
TYPES:
- ⟦{交感神経|こうかんしんけい}→交感神経：24839_koukanshinkei⟧: the sympathetic nervous system (activity, stress)
- {副交感神経|ふくこうかんしんけい}: the parasympathetic nervous system (rest, digestion)

USAGE:
In everyday Japanese, {自律神経|じりつしんけい} is talked about as something that can be "out of balance" and cause vague complaints such as poor sleep, fatigue, headaches or dizziness. The phrase {自律神経|じりつしんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧ is common in health magazines and advertising.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自律神経|じりつしんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to balance the autonomic nerves
- {自律神経|じりつしんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乱|みだ}れる→乱れる：09506_midareru⟧: to be thrown out of balance
- {自律神経|じりつしんけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働き：03557_hataraki⟧: the work of the autonomic nervous system

RELATED WORDS:
- {自律神経失調症|じりつしんけいしっちょうしょう}: autonomic imbalance, a common diagnosis for such vague symptoms
